limitations: Back-side bucket still contains visible scatter and incomplete fine detail.
Do not describe source-scene validation as newly captured real novel-view ground truth.
Offline video frame rate is not network playback FPS.

trajectory.motion: 360 degree orbit, two sinusoidal elevation cycles, always looking at target
trajectory.coordinate_system: FVV x right, y down, z forward; yaw/pitch degrees
trajectory.animation: model time advances 1 second per video second, loops at model boundary

decision: Activated the 45000-step orbit model; original 15000-step model retained. Orbit quality improved substantially, frontal PSNR remains about 1 dB lower and bucket temporal residual about 2.8 percent higher. No claim that back-side scatter or flicker is fully resolved.
